key.cogito.takeover: Take over from / hand over to the AI
cogito.llm.title: Cogito: model providers
cogito.llm.planner.tip: Turns each goal into steps. It runs rarely, so a stronger model pays off here.
cogito.llm.executor.tip: Carries out the steps no skill covers, turn by turn, looking at the screen. It runs often and needs a model that sees pictures.
cogito.llm.model.tip: The model's id at this provider, such as claude-haiku-5-5. Test connection lists the ones your key can use.
cogito.llm.effort.tip: How hard the model thinks. Default sends no setting at all, for models and servers that take none.
cogito.llm.name: Name
cogito.llm.base_url.tip: Empty: the maker's own API. For a server that speaks the OpenAI API, its address, usually ending in /v1, such as http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.
cogito.llm.key.tip: What you type shows as stars. Leave it empty to keep the key already stored.
cogito.llm.key.typed: A new key will be saved.
cogito.llm.key.cleared: The stored key will be removed.
cogito.llm.key.optional: No key: a local server may need none.
cogito.llm.key_variable.tip: Optional: an environment variable holding the key, used when none is stored. Without it, only the maker's own API reads its usual variable, such as OPENAI_API_KEY, so that key never goes to another server.
cogito.llm.images.tip: Turn off for a model that cannot see images. It then gets a note where each picture would be.
cogito.llm.price.tip: US dollars per million input and output tokens, for the spending limits. Left empty, Claude models use known prices and others are priced high, so the limits still stop a goal. Enter 0 for a free local server.
cogito.llm.test.unused: No layer uses this provider, so no model was asked.
cogito.llm.where: Saved in %s, outside every game folder, so sharing an instance never shares a key.
